verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every PR. It detects coding-agent-authored PRs and routes them to a different model for cross-model review. Agents can also self-review via the CLI and "greploop" until they reach a 5/5 confidence score with zero unresolved comments, and v5 runs parallel agent swarms while Kubernetes deployments scale horizontally. One user reports it catches real issues before human review, but missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of quality on agent-authored PRs specifically, and evidence of throughput at volumes beyond human review capacity.
